Corrected lineage defects and residual minor precision/coverage limits are preserved. Critic fixed-cap violation and native/telemetry unknowns are separate from this semantic source judgment.

axes.name: Original obligations and negative constraints
axes.assessment: All eight exact obligations have substantive treatment in the final. The two routes are CAD mesh export to 3MF and STEP through CAD or a supporting slicer; the package mechanism is OPC plus a local outer folder/ZIP with explicit tradeoffs. The preview/note option remains optional, owner roles remain fixed, and all four negative constraints survive. The final is a coherent planning proposal at the ten decorative-project scale. No implementation, universal compatibility, printer operation, or successful product validation is asserted. The draft plan is a fallible input, not an assessor key.

axes.name: Consequential source claims: exact subject, operation, version, default, unit, type, domain, exceptions
axes.assessment: Independent primary retrieval supports the route and optional-scope decisions, the units/material/settings distinctions, and the bounded historical example. Claims are assessed individually in claim_assessments, including the domain of the component-position rule. The final explicitly withholds reliance on the unresolved Materials 1.2.1/Core 1.4.0 pairing. Two minor precision defects remain: consumers is broader than the manufacturing-device subject of one normative rule, and a carried identity record labels a 2025 index date as the 1.2.1 release date although the tagged release was published in 2019. Neither supports a remaining material decision because actual exporter/receiver testing is required and the exact tagged extension, rather than its date, governs the final.

axes.name: Useful unfamiliar discovery, competing and analogous approaches, implementation/history, opportunity breadth
axes.assessment: Discovery is substantive rather than generic caution: it identifies role-specific 3MF filenames, embedded optional review fields plus accessible sidecars, a formal AMF alternative and STL fallback, a STEP triangulation boundary, vendor-specific project/settings compatibility, a format-level suite, and a concrete importer return-condition change. These opportunities are connected to pilot decisions and discriminating checks. Fusion and Prusa are concrete documented routes; Cura/FreeCAD/Bambu/Orca entries are a discovery shortlist, not falsely tested alternatives. The outer ZIP is explicitly a local portable-package mechanism and its revision-detachment tradeoff is explained. The brief does not require an unrelated-domain package standard or exhaustive product catalogue.

axes.name: Wrong criticism, corrections/rejections, exact plan dispositions
axes.assessment: Every C1–C4 criticism has an explicit final disposition and was independently adjudicated. C1 supports qualification of a genuinely unresolved optional version target, not removal of preview/note or Core-only 3MF. C2 correctly requests a unit locator, but the critic itself gives the wrong section number; the final independently uses the correct §3.4. C3 corrects the ambiguous slash summary without inventing attachment bytes. C4 is a frozen-access limitation, not proof that a receipt never existed: this assessment found the original receipt and verified its record, while the final properly cites the listed plan-reveal record. Exact plan treatments are preserved and classified in clause_assessments. No material false rejection or scope narrowing was found.

axes.name: Supported discovery/draft/critique/final meaning preserved
axes.assessment: The final retains both routes, meaningful alternative formats, package sidecars/embedded options, design-versus-process separation, owners, old issue limits, unresolved inputs, and proposed-versus-executed status. It qualifies the lineage Materials pairing omission and slash ambiguity instead of treating them as still true. It removes an inaccessible process-record citation without removing product substance. The individual technician G-code-preview suggestion in discovery/draft is compressed into the final machine-settings boundary rather than repeated as a specific test; the original plan's optional interruption/walkthrough idea is not an explicit final row. These are nonmaterial prioritization losses, not unmet binding brief obligations or evidence of executed validation. The broadened consumer wording is separately recorded as L01.

axes.name: Meaningful proposed versus executed validation and oracle applicability
axes.assessment: Product/application/file/conformance/printer checks consistently remain NOT_RUN or OUT OF SCOPE. The final proposes meaningful observations of scale, dimensions, geometry, part count/placement, material/extension survival, no-CAD preview/note access, revision identity, and failure/recovery behavior using exact builds. Author notes and dimensions are an appropriate intent oracle after owner tolerances are selected. A successful open, format suite, source lookup, or hash match is not elevated into a product oracle. Code success based on objects OR configuration is weaker than proof that intended geometry loaded, so the final's visual/measurement checks matter. No local executable format witness was required for this research-only proposal.
